W-Am: I just heard that Melinda can't stay until 5:00 p.m. Her son isn't feeling well, so she has to leave work early in order to get him from school. Would you be able to cover her duties? W-Am: It seems as if more people have been stopping by our store in recent weeks. That's probably because we've started selling albums that are hard to find on the internet. M-Au: Yes, I think you're right. But we're still losing a lot of customers to online music retailers. To ensure that people keep coming, we should ask some regional bands and singers to appear here at our business. W-Am: Funny you should suggest that. I've already reached out to several jazz and blues musicians in the area to see if they could come and sign autographs here. That's what many customers indicated they want in our satisfaction survey.

W-Am: Excuse me. I'd like to leave my car in this indoor parking lot for a couple of hours while I run some errands. My husband works at a dental clinic down the street, and he gave me his parking pass. Can I use it here? M-Cn: Unfortunately, it looks like your husband's pass expired two days ago. You'll have to pay to use our space. W-Am: Oh, okay. How does the payment process work? M-Cn: The fee for parking is $3.50 an hour. Here, I'll print a new ticket for you. When you leave, you can insert it into the machine located near the exit and pay using cash or credit card.

W-Am: Tyler, have you read the quarterly sales report yet? M-Cn: No, I'm planning to look through it on Thursday. I have to fly to Seattle this afternoon for um a trade exhibition, and I won't be back until Wednesday evening. Why, is there a problem? W-Am: Actually, there is. Sales of the company's latest dishwasher model are much lower than expected. The CEO wants our team to develop some new marketing strategies and present them tomorrow morning. We don't have much time to prepare, so I could really use your assistance. M-Cn: I'll take a later flight then. This sounds important, and I don't want to let the team down.

W-Am: I'm thinking of getting lunch at the cafeteria in our office building today. Do you want to join me? M-Cn: No, thanks. I ate there when I started working here and the food wasn't very good. I would prefer to dine at a restaurant. W-Am: Did you know that the food service company at our facility was changed last month in response to feedback from staff? Bistro Dining now provides meals. I find their dishes to be delicious. M-Cn: I probably missed that piece of news while I was on vacation three weeks ago. In that case, I'd be happy to come along. Just let me finish writing this email message first.

W-Am: Walter, I need you to update the staff manual for our investment bank's stock market research software. Here's a copy of the current handbook. M-Au: Thanks, but uh, when does the document need to be completed? W-Am: You'll have three days to work on it. Also, you should make revisions based on the version of the software that our IT workers are developing now. I asked the team to provide you with a list of changes to the program. M-Au: Got it. But can I look at the manual in an electronic format instead of this printout? It will be easier for me to refer to that.

I'm a little upset about the situation. W-Am: We switched to sending notices by email last month, Mr. Coburn. You should have received a message about the development. M-Cn: Really? I check my emails regularly and I never received one. Maybe the library hasn't been using my correct email address. W-Am: I apologize for the inconvenience. Um, here's what I can do. If you return the book today, you won't have to pay a late fee.

W-Am: Before we wrap up this meeting, let's talk about the position we need to fill in the bookkeeping department. After going through the applications, I think Cheryl Johnson looks promising. M-Cn: I agree. I was really impressed by her responses during the interview on Monday. What do you think, Dave? M-Au: I don't know. She doesn't have much experience working in the financial field. W-Am: It shouldn't be an issue though. It's an entry-level position. M-Cn: Right, she'll receive on-the-job training. M-Au: That's a good point. I don't have any objections to hiring her then. W-Am: Okay, but I should talk to the department head before making a final decision. I'll do that now.

M-Au: Jasmine, did you hear that loud party in the apartment upstairs last night? W-Am: Yeah, I had trouble sleeping because of it. I'm going to complain to the building management office. In addition, pets and young children should not be left unattended in parked vehicles. Information about the symptoms of heat stroke and methods of treatment is available on our website, along with tips for coping with the heat. Rain is forecasted for the area on August 8th, which will lead to a significant drop in temperature.

A customer who visits your website will be prompted to select an appointment time, and the program will then automatically assign an agent. Uh, the employee will be able to access the client's information to prepare for the meeting. For managers, this system can be used to see how many clients each team member is meeting and what products they have sold. Okay, let me show you how it works. Then I'll answer any questions you might have.

W-Am: Good morning, Mr. Davis. This is Marsha Foster. I'm calling about my interview on Tuesday. M-Au: Today, I'll be interviewing Matthew Walsh, the owner of the popular local studio Rustic Ceramics. M-Au: Be sure to check out his booth next to the stairway on the ground floor to view some of his creations. M-Au: If this interests you, just stop by the information desk to sign up for a session. M-Au: Now, let's meet Mr. Walsh.

W-Am: Good afternoon, Mr. Choi. This is Emily O'Neil from marketing. My manager asked that I contact the accounting department about buying a piece of furniture. We were just notified that someone from sales will be joining our team on October 13th, and we need another chair. The model we would like to purchase is available at Dixon's Office Supply for $45. I'll email you the requisition form in a few minutes. Please call me at extension 674 if you have any questions. Thank you.

Gordon Institute Publishes Study on Americans’ Eating and Exercise Habits

In its last survey conducted a decade ago, the Gordon Institute found that many Americans were not as active as they should be and often ate excessively. Now, the Atlanta-based nonprofit organization has released the comprehensive results of a new survey on the same topic.

According to the survey, 45 percent of Americans exercise once a week for 30 minutes a day or more. An additional 25 percent exercise three times a week for 30 minutes a day or more, and a further 10 percent exercise at least 30 minutes every day of the week. — [1] —.

Of the Americans who do exercise, 65 percent say they jog slowly, 25 percent say they lift weights, and the remaining 10 percent say they walk long distances or perform other activities. — [2] —. About 40 percent of this group say they don’t make any effort to regulate their food intake, while about 60 percent say they strive to eat healthily at least some of the time. — [3] —.

These results make for an interesting comparison to a similar survey the Gordon Institute published 20 years ago. In that survey, only 23 percent of Americans said they exercised at least once a week. Furthermore, the percentage of those monitoring their food intake and endeavoring to make smart food choices has risen 11 percent. — [4] —.

After a Long Absence, Thierry Martin is Back!

Thierry Martin used to be among the best-known and most admired guitarists in the world. His last album, La Defense (named after the Parisian business district), had sold more than 1 million copies and was still listed at the top of music charts after being there for six weeks. In addition, he was scheduled to contribute to the albums of several award-winning vocalists.

Then three years ago, while skiing during a holiday in Colorado, he broke his left arm. He canceled all scheduled interviews and appearances and had to postpone his impending world tour. Fans followed his progress anxiously as he slowly recovered, and it seemed like he had given up playing altogether for a time.

But now he is back making new recordings. According to an announcement on Martin's Web site, his next album, Normandy, will be released this November by BBS Records. Featuring 20 new songs and contributions by several famous vocalists including British pop star Carly Fey and American singer James Norwell, it's almost certain to be a best-seller this holiday season.

To build excitement for Normandy, Martin released the first single from that album. Entitled “Summer Squall,” it's a six-minute instrumental piece, incorporating hard rock influences. The popular music blog MP3Stream called the new single “one of his all-time greatest tracks.”

Showing the Way Forward for Cyclist

Since it was first developed, Global Positioning System technology, or GPS as it is more commonly known, has been focused on finding more efficient and accurate ways to direct drivers to their destinations. The average GPS available is able to tell anyone in a vehicle the quickest and most efficient route from point A to point B, but it is unable to provide cyclists or pedestrians the same information.

A new mobile application called Ped-Routes, funded by the cycling association Two Wheels, aims to change all that. Developers from FGG Software have used GPS technology to create maps that display less congested routes for a safer and more pleasant riding experience. In a move designed to make Ped-Routes appealing to more people, Two Wheels has also provided routes accessible to pedestrians.

Adam Jorgeson, the director of Two Wheels, said “We're very pleased with the new project and expect the first version to be launched before the end of the month. We are working with FGG on future versions that will provide cyclists with the option of taking the most scenic routes.” Ped-Routes is downloadable for a cost of $4.99, which gives users access for a period of one year.

To:	Melissa Hawk <techsupport@twowheels.com>
From:	Georgina McGrath <gjmcgrath@zoommail.com>
Subject:	Problems with Ped-Routes Mobile App
Date:	April 30

Dear Ms. Hawk,

I recently downloaded your group’s mobile application and wanted to mention an issue I encountered. I tried to use it to find my way around Providence. I just moved here last month for a job, so I’m still unfamiliar with the area. While I found that the app successfully guided me down some quiet, pleasant streets, it also once suggested that I take a much longer route than necessary. I followed the suggested route, and I later calculated that it took me over 40 minutes longer than the most direct route would have.

I appreciate that the application is primarily designed for bicyclists, but I still feel that this flaw needs to be addressed to make the software more useful. With that said, I would like to commend your organization for the general quality of the interface and the impressive speed at which the app works.

Best wishes,

Georgina McGrath

Autumn Leaf to Open Second Location in Buenos Aires

By Leonard Oldman

Autumn Leaf Hotels has announced plans to open a second branch in Buenos Aires’ Liniers district. Autumn Leaf public relations director Angelo Suarez said that the new hotel will be more like a temporary apartment building for businesspeople visiting the city. “There is a lot of demand from visitors who need to stay in Buenos Aires for long periods of time but don’t wish to spend a fortune on a full-service hotel,” he said. April 9

Leonard Oldman
World-Biz Magazine
Unit 542, Nelson Building, 432 W. 24th Street
New York City, NY 10013

Dear Mr. Oldman,

Thank you for writing the article about our hotel chain's expansion. We appreciate the publicity.

We will only start accepting reservations several weeks before our opening date, which hasn't been established yet. Your article specified the month the hotel would likely open, but we are actually planning for somewhat later than that.

Angelo Suarez

questions.stem: Why is Malinda unable to stay until 5 P.M.?

options.text: She is not feeling very well.
She must get a family member.
She has to drop off some supplies.
She will go to a school function.

questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "Her son isn't feeling well, so she has to leave work early in order to get him from school." Melinda phải về sớm vì con trai cô ấy bị ốm và cô ấy cần đón con từ trường. Đáp án B đúng vì cụm từ "get a family member" bao hàm việc đón con trai của cô ấy.

questions.stem: What does the man agree to do?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. "Would you be able to cover her duties?" Người phụ nữ hỏi liệu người đàn ông có thể làm thay công việc của Melinda không và anh ấy đã đồng ý giúp đỡ. Đáp án D là chính xác vì "fill in for a colleague" có nghĩa là làm thay cho đồng nghiệp.

questions.stem: According to the woman, where did the man previously work?
questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "Seeing as you used to be a receptionist at an advertising company, you should be able to handle everything." Người phụ nữ nhắc lại kinh nghiệm làm việc trước đây của người đàn ông. Đáp án B đúng vì "advertising company" trong bài nghe tương ứng với "advertising firm" trong đáp án.

questions.stem: Where do the speakers most likely work?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "It seems as if more people have been stopping by our store in recent weeks. That's probably because we've started selling albums that are hard to find on the internet." Câu này nghĩa là có vẻ như nhiều người ghé qua cửa hàng của chúng tôi những tuần gần đây, có lẽ vì chúng tôi bắt đầu bán các album khó tìm trên mạng. Việc bán album khẳng định họ làm việc tại một cửa hàng băng đĩa.

questions.stem: What does the man recommend?
questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "To ensure that people keep coming, we should ask some regional bands and singers to appear here at our business." Câu này nghĩa là để đảm bảo mọi người tiếp tục đến, chúng ta nên mời một số ban nhạc và ca sĩ trong khu vực xuất hiện tại cửa hàng. Việc mời các ban nhạc và ca sĩ chính là hành động liên hệ với các nghệ sĩ biểu diễn địa phương.

questions.stem: According to the woman, what do some customers want?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "I've already reached out to several jazz and blues musicians in the area to see if they could come and sign autographs here." Câu này nghĩa là tôi đã liên hệ với vài nhạc sĩ jazz và blues trong vùng để xem họ có thể đến và ký tặng tại đây không. Việc ký tặng chính là mong muốn nhận được chữ ký của nghệ sĩ từ phía khách hàng.

questions.stem: Where most likely does the conversation take place?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. Người phụ nữ nói "I'd like to leave my car in this indoor parking lot for a couple of hours" (Tôi muốn để xe trong bãi đỗ xe trong nhà này vài tiếng). Bãi đỗ xe trong nhà chính là một nhà để xe (garage).

questions.stem: What does the woman say about her husband?

options.text: He forgot to print a document.
He wants to buy a monthly pass.
He is employed by a nearby business.

questions.explanation: Đáp án C. Người phụ nữ giải thích rằng "My husband works at a dental clinic down the street" (Chồng tôi làm việc ở phòng khám nha khoa cuối phố). Điều này có nghĩa là anh ấy được thuê bởi một doanh nghiệp gần đó.

questions.stem: What should the woman do when she leaves?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. Người đàn ông hướng dẫn rằng "When you leave, you can insert it into the machine located near the exit and pay using cash or credit card." (Khi cô rời đi, cô có thể cho vé vào máy đặt gần lối ra và thanh toán bằng tiền mặt hoặc thẻ tín dụng). Hành động này có nghĩa là cô ấy cần thực hiện thanh toán.

questions.stem: When is the man planning to return from Seattle?
questions.explanation: Đáp án B. Người đàn ông nói "I won't be back until Wednesday evening." trong đoạn hội thoại. Câu này có nghĩa là ông ấy sẽ không quay lại cho đến tối thứ Tư, nên đáp án đúng là thứ Tư.

questions.stem: What will probably take place tomorrow morning?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. Người phụ nữ giải thích "The CEO wants our team to develop some new marketing strategies and present them tomorrow morning." Câu này có nghĩa là CEO muốn nhóm trình bày các chiến lược tiếp thị vào sáng mai, tương ứng với một buổi thuyết trình tiếp thị.

questions.stem: Why does the man say, “I'll take a later flight, then”?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. Người đàn ông nói "I'll take a later flight then. This sounds important, and I don't want to let the team down." Câu này cho thấy ông ấy quyết định dời chuyến bay để ở lại giúp đỡ nhóm, thể hiện sự đồng ý với yêu cầu của người phụ nữ.

questions.stem: What is the conversation mainly about?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. Người phụ nữ mở đầu câu chuyện bằng việc rủ người đàn ông đi ăn trưa tại "I'm thinking of getting lunch at the cafeteria in our office building today." (Tôi đang nghĩ đến việc ăn trưa tại căng tin trong tòa nhà văn phòng của chúng ta hôm nay). Cả đoạn hội thoại xoay quanh việc họ có nên ăn ở đó hay không, nên đây là chủ đề chính.

questions.stem: According to the woman, why has there been a change?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. Người phụ nữ giải thích rằng công ty cung cấp suất ăn đã thay đổi "in response to feedback from staff" (để phản hồi lại ý kiến đóng góp từ nhân viên). Cụm từ này đồng nghĩa với việc đáp ứng các nhận xét, bình luận của người lao động.

questions.stem: When will the man most likely join the woman?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. Sau khi đồng ý đi ăn, người đàn ông nói "Just let me finish writing this email message first." (Hãy để tôi viết xong tin nhắn email này trước đã). Điều này có nghĩa là anh ấy sẽ đi cùng sau khi hoàn thành công việc đang làm dở.

questions.stem: Where most likely do the speakers work?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. Người phụ nữ nói "I need you to update the staff manual for our investment bank's stock market research software." Câu này có nghĩa là tôi cần bạn cập nhật sổ tay nhân viên cho phần mềm nghiên cứu thị trường chứng khoán của ngân hàng đầu tư chúng ta. Vì họ làm việc tại ngân hàng đầu tư nên đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.stem: What does the man ask the woman about?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. Người đàn ông hỏi "when does the document need to be completed?" Câu này dịch là khi nào tài liệu cần phải hoàn thành. Đây chính là câu hỏi về thời hạn (deadline) của công việc được giao.

questions.stem: What does the man mean when he says, “It will be easier for me to refer to that”?

options.text: He wants to use updated software.
He would rather print a brochure.
He wants to view an electronic file.
He would like to reference a memo.

questions.explanation: Đáp án C. Người đàn ông hỏi "But can I look at the manual in an electronic format instead of this printout? It will be easier for me to refer to that." Câu này nghĩa là nhưng tôi có thể xem sổ tay ở định dạng điện tử thay vì bản in này không, nó sẽ dễ dàng hơn cho tôi để tham khảo. Việc ông ấy muốn dùng định dạng điện tử thay cho bản in chứng tỏ ông ấy muốn xem file điện tử.

questions.stem: Why is the man calling?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. "I'm a little upset about the situation." Người đàn ông gọi điện để bày tỏ sự không hài lòng vì ông ấy có sách quá hạn nhưng không nhận được thông báo nhắc nhở như trước đây. Hành động này chính là việc đưa ra lời phàn nàn về dịch vụ.

questions.stem: According to the woman, what did the library do last month?
questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "We switched to sending notices by email last month, Mr. Coburn." Người phụ nữ giải thích rằng thư viện đã thay đổi quy trình thông báo từ gọi điện thoại sang gửi email vào tháng trước. Đây chính là sự thay đổi về thủ tục thông báo.

questions.stem: What does the woman say she can do?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. "If you return the book today, you won't have to pay a late fee." Người phụ nữ đề nghị rằng nếu ông ấy trả sách ngay trong ngày hôm nay thì sẽ được miễn phí phạt quá hạn. "Waive a charge" đồng nghĩa với việc không phải trả phí phạt.

questions.stem: What was held on Monday?
questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "I was really impressed by her responses during the interview on Monday." Người nói nhắc đến việc ấn tượng với câu trả lời của ứng viên trong buổi phỏng vấn vào thứ Hai. Vì vậy, một buổi phỏng vấn xin việc đã diễn ra vào ngày này.

questions.stem: What is mentioned about Sheryl Johnson?

options.text: She will provide a work sample.

questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "She doesn't have much experience working in the financial field." Người nói trực tiếp đề cập rằng ứng viên không có nhiều kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực tài chính. Điều này tương ứng với việc cô ấy thiếu kinh nghiệm liên quan.

questions.stem: What will the woman probably do next?
